Text.SourceString: 这些数字，跟这座城市的异象波动状况有关？
Text.LocalizedString: Are these numbers related to the anomaly fluctuation in the city?

Text.SourceString: 对，<blue>「维特海默值」</>——衡量目标对象背离现实浓度的数值。
Text.LocalizedString: Yes, the <blue>Wertheimer Index</>— measures how much an object deviates from reality.

Text.SourceString: 持续监测城市各区域维特海默值的变化，我们便能对新出现的异象快速作出反应。
Text.LocalizedString: By monitoring the changes in the Wertheimer Index across different areas, we can respond to emerging anomalies.

Text.SourceString: ——半港区的维特海默值波动幅度较为剧烈，收容六组的人，撑不了多久。
Text.LocalizedString: —The Wertheimer Index in the Halfport strongly fluctuates. Unit 6 won't last very long.

Text.SourceString: 啊呀，还以为终于能大闹一场了呢……区区Ⅴ级异象……
Text.LocalizedString: Oh man, Just a Class V? I thought I could finally have some fun…
I'll go ahead. See you at the site.
Who's that?
Nunya business.
Hello?
Anybody here?
Over here!
Hello?
Hey! Over here!
Put the book back.

Text.SourceString: 按我，要找人就按我……记得不要太用力！
Text.LocalizedString: Press me. If you're looking for someone, press on me… but not too hard!

Text.SourceString: 最后一击——决一胜负吧，小海獭！
Text.LocalizedString: Final blow—let's settle this, little otter!

Text.SourceString: ……一大早就哐啷哐啷吵死了……塔吉多你在干嘛？
Text.LocalizedString: All this racket early in the morning… Taygedo, what are you doing?

Text.SourceString: 可恶，昨晚就不该把最后一瓶也喝了……解酒药……解酒药在哪儿来着……
Text.LocalizedString: Darn, shouldn't have finished that last bottle last night… Where's the hangover medicine…

Text.SourceString: 哪儿来的脏东西？！给我死！
Text.LocalizedString: What's this dirty thing?! Die!

Text.SourceString: 这位是新加入的鉴定师，伊波恩的古董鉴定就靠{Gender}|gender(他,她)了！
Text.LocalizedString: This is our new appraiser, Eibon's antique evaluations depend on {Gender}|gender(him,her)!

Text.SourceString: 今后就麻烦大家了，我会认真工作的。
Text.LocalizedString: From now on, I'll do my best.
Hehe, I'll watch your back!

Text.SourceString: 有了鉴定师，浔总算可以少收点假货了吧？
Text.LocalizedString: With an appraiser, Hotori can stop buying fake goods, right?
You little brat!

Text.SourceString: 我再来依次介绍下吧。我和塔吉多主要负责店里的古董维护和生活后勤。
Text.LocalizedString: Allow me to properly introduce everyone. Taygedo and I handle antique maintenance and logistics.
(Sorry about earlier!)

Text.SourceString: 达芙蒂尔小姐负责店内与四周的安全事务。
Text.LocalizedString: Daffodill is responsible for security.
Hello.

Text.SourceString: 娜娜莉、早雾和埃德嘉，店里承接的低级异象事件大部分由他们外出处理。
Text.LocalizedString: Nanally, Sakiri, and Edgar handle most of the low threat Anomaly cases.
Hello.

Text.SourceString: 手上没什么工作的时候，可以跟我们一起行动！
Text.LocalizedString: When there's no work, you can join us!

Text.SourceString: 什么嘛，我们又不是处理不了……哼，当然啦，如果你想见见世面，也不是不可以带上你。
Text.LocalizedString: Not that we need the help… but if you wanna be amazed, you can come along

Text.SourceString: 嗯，我对异象事件也很感兴趣。
Text.LocalizedString: Hmm. Anomaly cases interest me too.
And this is Hotori, the owner of Eibon—

Text.SourceString: 负责每天酩酊大醉！好酒……好酒……干杯！
Text.LocalizedString: In charge of getting drunk every day! "Cheers, I'll drink to that."

Text.SourceString: 塔吉多给我抓住她！晚饭加十颗海胆——我要教训这个小矮子！
Text.LocalizedString: Taygedo, grab her! Ten urchins for dinner—I'm teaching this little one a lesson!

Text.SourceString: 收工，找老板结账然后拍照~
Text.LocalizedString: Time to wrap up, let's get paid and take our photo.
(Taygedo is great at posing!)

Text.SourceString: 埃德嘉、早雾，拍照的时候允许你们轮流亲吻我的左手！
Text.LocalizedString: Edgar, Sakiri, you can take turns kissing my left hand for the photo!
Uh…
No way!

Text.SourceString: 装神弄鬼的家伙！交易？我的愿望可不是那么便宜的东西！
Text.LocalizedString: Creepy psychic fraud! A deal? My wish is worth a lot more than that!

Text.SourceString: 像您这样不由分说上来就动手的客人，本店可是……会感到困扰的啊……
Text.LocalizedString: People who punch instead of talk aren't really… welcomed here… Ah…
Wowza!
Could it be… are you Taygedo?
(Oh no, oh no, oh no… What to do what to do?!)
Boss!
Whoa…
Boss! So this is where you've been…!

Text.SourceString: 只带两个保镖外出太危险了，请随我们回去！
Text.LocalizedString: It's too risky with only two bodyguards! Please, come back with us!
(You guys…)
(Hmph… Enough chatter! No interruptions today!)
(Everyone, make way for Taygedo!)
Uh, yes! Boss!
Wooow!
(Phew…)
(Dear Tako, it's a pleasure to meet you…)

Text.SourceString: 塔吉多！比咱想象的还要酷！
Text.LocalizedString: Taygedo! You're even cooler than we thought! (Hehe)

Text.SourceString: 站住！你们都不准出手，这只臭鸟，看我怎么抓住它！
Text.LocalizedString: Stop! No one else touches it. This annoying bird, I'm gonna catch it so hard!
You… stay still! Don't run!
Catch it!

Text.SourceString: 这是什么？我们之前来调查都没有看到这东西！果然冬司的失踪是和这个异象有关吧？
Text.LocalizedString: What's this? We didn't see this during our previous investigation! Toshi's disappearance must be connected to this anomaly!

Text.SourceString: 抱歉……我也没有查到这个异象的资料。
Text.LocalizedString: Sorry… I couldn't find any data on this anomaly.

Text.SourceString: 连我的智囊团第一人都不知道这个异象？你脑袋里可是装着一个图书馆诶！
Text.LocalizedString: Even the brainiac doesn't know? You've got a whole library in your head!
Hey!
Puke—

Text.SourceString: 这个东西！怎么又被你吞进去了！
Text.LocalizedString: Oh my gosh! Why did you swallow that again?!

Text.SourceString: 它这——又是在生哪门子气啊？
Text.LocalizedString: Hey! Why is this thing angry again?

Text.SourceString: 咳咳咳咳……咳咳咳咳……这、这是哪里……
Text.LocalizedString: Cough, cough… cough, cough, cough… Wh-what is this place…?
Dan-Dandelion?
Woof! Woof!

Text.SourceString: 是蒲公英！我就知道是你！
Text.LocalizedString: It's Dandelion! I knew it was you!
Woof! Woof, woof, woof!

Text.SourceString: 蒲公英，这段时间你到底跑到哪里去了你这只坏狗！呜呜呜呜……我怎么都找不到你……吓死我了呜呜呜呜………
Text.LocalizedString: Dandelion, where have you been, you bad doggy! *Sniffles* I've been looking for you… Aw, you really scared me soulless!
Thank you for getting here in time.

Text.SourceString: 客气，这一路也辛苦你照顾娜娜莉他们。
Text.LocalizedString: No need for thanks. I appreciate you taking care of Nanally and the others along the way.
(Taygedo proudly presents a special performance!)
Woah!!
That's amazing!
Tayge!
It's us!

Text.SourceString: （塔吉多……居然能做到这种地步吗？）
Text.LocalizedString: (Taygedo… can actually do something like this?)
Tayge!
(This! For Tako!)

Text.SourceString: （塔、塔吉多想要告诉……塔可小姐……）
Text.LocalizedString: (Ta-Taygedo wants to tell… Tako…)
Taygedo… uh, huh?
Ta?
(Whawhawhat's going on!)

Text.SourceString: 不是？刚刚不还好好的吗！发生什么事了！
Text.LocalizedString: Wasn't everything okay? What in the world happened?!

Text.SourceString: 糟了……难道是塔吉多的能力，促成本是异象的「随心泥」失控了……
Text.LocalizedString: Oh no… Could Taygedo's ability have caused the Imaginadough to spiral out of control?
Eek!
Miss Tako, look out!
Boss!

Text.SourceString: 哎呀，在这里碰到，可真是缘分呐~
Text.LocalizedString: Oh, look who it is! Lucky me, running into you.

Text.SourceString: 喂喂，怎么一脸困惑？难道……已经不认得我了？！
Text.LocalizedString: Hey, what's with the confused face? Don't you recognize me?
Uh… Captain Baicang?

Text.SourceString: Bingo~我就知道，你不是那么冷漠绝情的人呢~
Text.LocalizedString: Bingo! I knew you weren't that cold-hearted.
Baicang!

Text.SourceString: 遇到他之后如果发现陷入了特殊情况，沟通的事情就交给我了，不是这么规划过了吗？
Text.LocalizedString: Huh… Look. Didn't we agree that I'd be the one to communicate with him if we find him under special circumstances?

Text.SourceString: 好了。总算是能跟你面对面讲话了。
Text.LocalizedString: There, we're finally having a conversation now.

Text.SourceString: 你说这个浑身长满杂草的模样是「新生」？
Text.LocalizedString: You're covered in weeds. Is this what you meant when you said you were "reborn"?

Text.SourceString: 这样啊，能这么斩钉截铁地断言，一定是因为这地方破落到连个能用的镜子都没给你剩下……
Text.LocalizedString: And you sound very sure. Well, guess there isn't even a mirror around for you to check yourself with…

Text.SourceString: 哈哈开玩笑，是已经有所觉悟，不打算再次出现在海特洛市的大街上了吧？
Text.LocalizedString: Just kidding. Guess you've made up your mind to never show up again on the streets of Hethereau, yeah?
Wait…

Text.SourceString: 又或是想等父母找到这里来，把他们拉下水一并吞噬，在这个全新的家园里其乐融融……手牵手和外面的社会说再见？
Text.LocalizedString: Or were you thinking about waiting for your parents… to come here for you… and build your lovely family over here, tucked away from the rest of world?

Text.SourceString: 这就是你现在的真实想法？是你爱他们的方式啊~原来如此！
Text.LocalizedString: Is that really what you're thinking now? So that's how you love them. I see!

Text.SourceString: 如果觉得我说的不对……就「由你自己来说说看」吧。
Text.LocalizedString: If you think I'm wrong… well, why don't you do the "talking" instead?
What's wrong, Taygedo?
Nngh… it hurts…
(The bat… it's talking…)
No… Not time yet…
Five… Five more minutes…
(Bat, became a person!)
Ah. TV… Talking…
Lacrimosa senpai!
Lacrimosa senpai! Where are you?
Is that Mint?
Coco!
Quiet as a mouse… quietttt…
Hungry…
Tomato jelly…
Ah, senpai! wait up!
You gotta pay first! You can't just take it!
…Eh?

Text.SourceString: 呃……前辈她偶尔会出现这种小意外……
Text.LocalizedString: Uh… senpai tends to have these little… accidents sometimes…
Lacrimosa… didn't mean to.
…I kind of get why the public misunderstood now.

Text.SourceString: 事后、事后都会照价赔偿的……
Text.LocalizedString: We'll pay—we'll pay for everything later, I promise…

Text.SourceString: 请受试者正对屏幕，即将为您拍摄证件照。
Text.LocalizedString: Please face the screen directly, test subject. Your ID photo will be taken momentarily.
(Taygedo, perfect smile!)

Text.SourceString: 请受试者保持平视，不要踮脚。
Text.LocalizedString: Test subject, please keep your gaze level and don't stand on your tiptoes.
(Taygedo, busted!)
Is he carrying the invitation?
Yes, he is.
Invitation located.

Text.SourceString: 完成「替换」后，别忘了告诉哈索尔。
Text.LocalizedString: After the swap, don't forget to tell Hathor.
Hmm?

Text.SourceString: 哈索尔，要遵守交通规则哦~
Text.LocalizedString: Hathor, be sure to obey the traffic laws!

Text.SourceString: 不是，现在的狗仔，都开雷加利亚玩跟踪的？
Text.LocalizedString: Paparazzi can afford Regalia these days?!

Text.SourceString: 嘿——今天就让你瞧瞧，什么叫真摇滚！
Text.LocalizedString: Hey—today, I'll show you what real rock is!
Bidding 1 Fons.
And Sold!

Text.SourceString: 一亿？！怎么不按剧本来啊！
Text.LocalizedString: One hundred million?! How could you do that!
Looks like victory goes to me!
Here we go!

Text.SourceString: 哼哼，我一直都很想试试这招……
Text.LocalizedString: Heh heh, I've been dying to try this move…
Huh?
Pretty awesome, huh?
Look!
Whew!
Let's practice again next time.
Mhm.

Text.SourceString: 饿了，去看看大叔有没有做好吃的！
Text.LocalizedString: I'm hungry! Let's go see if the old man's made anything good!

Text.SourceString: （不和家族站在一起的老大，不算是真正的老大……）
Text.LocalizedString: (If you don't stand with your family… you're not much of a boss…)

Text.SourceString: 哦，这句这句！（我势必要带着家族，在这片土地上站稳脚跟。）
Text.LocalizedString: Oh, this one! (I swear, I'll lead my family and claim our place on this land.)
Thanks a lot!

Text.SourceString: 这就是我心里当之无愧的影史第一。
Text.LocalizedString: Honestly, this is hands-down my favorite film ever.
Next time, we should watch it together!
Alrighty.
The scent of ocean breeze… it's so refreshing.
Thank you… Coco…
For what?
Hehe.
Is this...
Bread, tomatoes… Ketchup.

Text.SourceString: 不知不觉，已经这么晚了啊。
Text.LocalizedString: Oh my, it's already so late.

Text.SourceString: 安魂曲今天很努力，对异能的掌控明显更熟练了。之后再……
Text.LocalizedString: You worked really hard today, and your Esper Ability clearly improved. We can do this another...
Lacrimosa?

Text.SourceString: 说起来，安魂曲会飞，应该很习惯高空的景致吧？
Text.LocalizedString: Oh yeah, you can fly, right? Aren't you used to sightseeing from high up?

Text.SourceString: 唔……没有。飞太高，很累。很少，飞到这么高。
Text.LocalizedString: Umm... not really. Flying too high... tiring. Rarely... fly this high.
Do you see any stars?

Text.SourceString: 没有……但是，下面的汽车，都变得好小，亮闪闪的。
Text.LocalizedString: Not yet... but cars down there, tiny and sparkly.
Buildings... also sparkly.

Text.SourceString: 原来地面上，有更多星星……
Text.LocalizedString: So there are... more stars on land...
Boss... what did you wish for?

Text.SourceString: 那还用问吗？当然是发大财咯~
Text.LocalizedString: Do you even need to ask? To strike it rich, of course!
That's so like you, Boss...

Love and Peace
To those at Eibon
Thank you.
Get some good rest, Boss.

Text.SourceString: 「隐火症」，涉异病症，初次发现于冷山医院，可传染，方式未知，无治愈手段。
Text.LocalizedString: The Phantom Burn Syndrome, an anomaly disease, was first discovered at Coldmount Hospital. Transmissible; mechanism unknown; no known cure.

Text.SourceString: 发病早期，患者会因身体局部的灼痛感而情绪不稳定、出现自毁倾向……
Text.LocalizedString: Initially, patients experience localized burning sensations that cause emotional instability and self-destructive tendencies…

Text.SourceString: 即使在并无烧伤的情况下，患者也会要求用绷带对患处进行包扎，这种方式疑似能减轻其灼痛感和不安心理。
Text.LocalizedString: Despite the absence of actual burns, patients will request bandages to wrap the affected areas. This method appears to alleviate their burning pain and psychological distress.

Text.SourceString: 发病中期，症状会逐步扩散，患者会尽可能地用绷带包裹自己的肢体甚至头部，严重影响活动，
Text.LocalizedString: As the disorder progresses, the symptoms gradually spread. Patients will wrap as much of their body as possible, including their heads. This severely impairs mobility.

Text.SourceString: 同时，将无法进行沟通，停止进食，丧失睡眠，任何尝试摘下绷带的举动会引发剧烈的反抗。
Text.LocalizedString: They will also become unable to communicate, eat, or sleep. Any attempt to remove the bandages will trigger violent resistance.

Text.SourceString: 哪怕是处于深度麻醉状态下，也会直接苏醒。
Text.LocalizedString: Even if under deep anesthesia, patients will immediately regain consciousness and attempt to resist.

Text.SourceString: 发病后期，症状扩散至全身……
Text.LocalizedString: In the final stages, symptoms will have spread over the entire body…

Text.SourceString: 冷山医院的一切都是施特林家族的财产，包括他们的病，他们的生，他们的死。
Text.LocalizedString: Everything at Coldmount Hospital is the Stirling family's property. Their illnesses, their lives, and even their deaths.

Text.SourceString: 当家族将这一批实验品以患者的名义收入冷山医院时，我就已经做好了最坏的打算。
Text.LocalizedString: The moment the family recruited these patients to be test subjects, I prepared for the worst.

Text.SourceString: 但我从未想过，最终的差错竟然出在了一个小小的实验员身上。
Text.LocalizedString: But I never imagined that a mere researcher would become the last straw.

Text.SourceString: 家族给所有人许诺了财富与健康，也包括他在内。可为何他要背叛？
Text.LocalizedString: The family promised wealth and wellbeing to everyone, including to him… So why? Why did he betray us?

Text.SourceString: 因为对那些本就无法治愈之人产生了怜悯？
Text.LocalizedString: Was it out of pity for those who were beyond saving?

Text.SourceString: 还是因为自己也感染了异病，觉得生命毫无意义，所以和我们鱼死网破？
Text.LocalizedString: Or because… he'd become infected by an anomaly disease, and decided to drag us all down with him to share in his despair?

Text.SourceString: 无法理解，我也没有时间关心。
Text.LocalizedString: I don't get it, nor do I have the patience to figure it out.

Text.SourceString: 那些失控的实验品已经把这个创造了无数奇迹的地方，变成了炼狱。
Text.LocalizedString: Those test subjects, who are out of control, turned a place of countless miracles into a living hell.

Text.SourceString: 但即便如此，护理部也有义务将所有家族的痕迹抹除。
Text.LocalizedString: But even so, the Nursing Department is obligated to erase all traces of the family's involvement.
Mission! Accomplished!
That's why we're the best!

Text.SourceString: 萌萌异象系列大促销，走过路过进来看一下！
Text.LocalizedString: Adorable Anomaly Series on mega sale! Don't miss out! Come check it out now!
Is that Sakiri's voice?
Sakiri?
Y-you've got the wrong person!
Sakiri! Sakiri!
Wotcha doin' out here?
Don't tell anyone else about this...!

Text.SourceString: 这个口味！还有这个口味！全加上！
Text.LocalizedString: This flavor! And this flavor too! All of them!
I'm such a genius!
Ki! Rou! Maru!!!

Text.SourceString: 就这么上车了?如果这是个圈套，鉴定师岂不是自投罗网？
Text.LocalizedString: You hopped on just like that? Wouldn't you be in danger if this was a trap?

Text.SourceString: 九原小姐应该没什么恶意……
Text.LocalizedString: I assumed you wouldn't do me any harm…

Text.SourceString: 这么信任我呢~不过鉴定师在海特洛还是小心些。暗地里，可有不少双眼睛盯上了你~
Text.LocalizedString: Thanks for your trust, but you should stay alert in Hethereau. A good number of people are eying you in the shadows.
Seems like I’m popular.

Text.SourceString: 鉴定师，不必怀疑这份异能的价值。
Text.LocalizedString: Appraiser, don't doubt the value of your abilities.

Text.SourceString: 今天的这顿饭，鉴定师还满意吗？
Text.LocalizedString: So, how do you find the meal?

Text.SourceString: 夜景好看得让人有些意外。
Text.LocalizedString: The night view is surprisingly gorgeous.

Text.SourceString: 意外吗？我倒觉得，有些风景，本就只属于懂得欣赏的人。
Text.LocalizedString: Surprisingly? I actually think… some views are meant for those who know how to appreciate them.
Mhm…?

Text.SourceString: 你若愿意跟我走，能看到的景色，可不止这些~
Text.LocalizedString: If you're willing to come with me, you could see far more sights than this.
Umm…
Hush. Hold your words right now.

Text.SourceString: 有些话，可以留到下次说。
Text.LocalizedString: Some words are best kept for later.
Appraiser, wanna… take a walk?
Umm…
Never mind then, you goody two shoes.
Next time… let's do grown-up things.
Is that so?
Hathor?
Ahem… Appraiser…

Text.SourceString: 那么多的研究，那么多的牺牲……我把我的一切都奉献在了手术台上，到头来所有人都辜负了我……
Text.LocalizedString: So much research, so many sacrifices… I devoted everything I had to the operating table. In the end, I got nothing but betrayals…

Text.SourceString: 为什么要露出一副看到怪物的模样？为什么不愿意听我的话？为什么不肯相信我？
Text.LocalizedString: Why do you look like you're staring at a monster? Why won't you listen to me? Why won't anyone believe me?

Text.SourceString: 为什么？为什么为什么为什么？明明就差一点，就差一点！
Text.LocalizedString: Why, why, why, why why? I was this close! THIS CLOSE!

Text.SourceString: 啊，离我只有一步之遥的一点希望，他们连这个也要从我手上夺走。
Text.LocalizedString: A sliver of hope, just within reach, and they want to take even that away from me.

Text.SourceString: ……算了，愤怒毫无意义，他们只是一群白痴，我早就知道的。
Text.LocalizedString: Forget it… Why do I even bother to get angry? They're just a bunch of imbeciles. I knew that a long time ago.

Text.SourceString: 一切都结束了。研究不可能再继续下去……那些「实验品」……它们还可以发挥最后的价值……
Text.LocalizedString: It's over. The research can't keep going… those "specimen"… still have their final use…

Text.SourceString: 什么「隐火症」，什么家族，都无所谓了，事到如今，谁都别想逃掉……
Text.LocalizedString: Be it the Phantom Burn Syndrome or family… everything is over. At this point, none can get away…

Text.SourceString: 哈哈……哈哈哈哈……这就是他们亲手选择的结局。
Text.LocalizedString: Haha…Hahahaha… So this is the ending they chose.

Text.SourceString: ……让这座医院……得到彻底的解放吧。
Text.LocalizedString: Let this hospital… be thoroughly… liberated.

Text.SourceString: ……又是这个故事……已经不记得是第几次了……
Text.LocalizedString: This story again…? I can't remember how many times it has been…

Text.SourceString: 这次我是谁？是人，是怪物，是病痛，唯独不是我自己。
Text.LocalizedString: Who am I this time? Am I human, monster, or the sickness itself? I only know that I am not myself.

Text.SourceString: 某一天，我睁开眼，是感染了诅咒般的病症，不惜一切代价自救的医生。
Text.LocalizedString: One day, I opened my eyes, and I see a doctor consumed by a curse-like sickness, willing to anything to save himself.

Text.SourceString: 又或者，我是隐约意识到危机，却愚蠢到没能逃脱的管理者。
Text.LocalizedString: Or maybe, I'm the manager who saw the danger coming, but was foolish enough to stay.

Text.SourceString: 甚至是这座医院本身，亲自操控着这些可悲的人们走向灭亡。
Text.LocalizedString: Or I was the hospital itself, marching all those pathetic souls to death.

Text.SourceString: 我扮演了那么多不同的角色，无数次试图改变命运的轨迹，而结局始终只有一个……
Text.LocalizedString: I played so many roles, and I tried countless times to change fate, but in the end, there was only one ending…

Text.SourceString: 噩梦如同沼泽，不论如何挣扎都会被吞噬在无边无际的黑暗里。
Text.LocalizedString: Nightmares are like swamps. No matter how much you struggle, you get devoured by endless darkness.

Text.SourceString: 但这一切仅仅是虚构吗？还是发生在过去的现实？我再也分不清了。
Text.LocalizedString: But was everything the real life? Or was I reliving the past? I can't tell anymore.

Text.SourceString: 那么你呢，陌生人？你所经历的，到底是事实还是臆想？
Text.LocalizedString: What about you, stranger? Did you experience the real life, or was it just fantasy?

Text.SourceString: 你所见证的「真相」，它的「真相」又是什么？
Text.LocalizedString: And the what is the "truth" about the "truth" you just saw?
Daffodill!
Leave it to me.
It's you.

Text.SourceString: 你说好端端的人，也没啥毛病，怎么突然就昏迷不醒了？
Text.LocalizedString: I mean, they were in perfect shape, with no issues at all. How did they fall into a coma?

Text.SourceString: 这种事说不准啊。人啊，有时候也挺脆弱的。
Text.LocalizedString: These things are hard to predict. People can be fragile.
This bear must… w-w-warn you…!
Careful! The bear is transforming!

Text.SourceString: 熊要告诫你……为小孩子操心的人都会招致不幸……
Text.LocalizedString: This bear must warn you… worrying about kids only brings forth misfortune…
What in Hethereau…? YUCK!
Finally revealing your true nature…?
Just like you! HAHAHAHA!
Cursed humans…
All those who abandoned teddy bears…
Adler? Where are you?
That ferry… is sailing on the land?

Text.SourceString: 从何而来……又将……成为什么……
Text.LocalizedString: From where we come… to where… we go?

Text.SourceString: （欢迎泥~欢迎泥~能康到船船的客人~！）
Text.LocalizedString: (Henlo, henlo, guest who can see the ferry!)

Text.SourceString: 扭扭？居然在这里也能看见你们这群小家伙。
Text.LocalizedString: I didn't expect to see you little guys here.
What's that?

Text.SourceString: （太阳。不升起，不落下。没有黑夜，没有晨曦。）
Text.LocalizedString: (Da sun. No rise, no set, no morning, no night.)
Fog,
echoes of waves,
and… a giant statue?

Text.SourceString: 与黑羽小姐的占卜对上了，这里应该就是娜娜莉走丢的异象空间。
Text.LocalizedString: These all match Blackbird's divination. This must be the Anomalous Realm Nanally got lost in.

Text.SourceString: 出于什么原因只有我一个人进来了……得先告诉大家。
Text.LocalizedString: For some reason I'm the only one here… I need to tell the others.

Text.SourceString: 忒修斯之舵……它不会允许规则被打破
Text.LocalizedString: The Helm of Theseus… it won't allow rules to be broken…
It must…
Sail to the past…

Text.SourceString: 是它不允许，还是你不敢改变？
Text.LocalizedString: Does it make the rules, or do you make the rules?
I can bring you out,

Text.SourceString: 带你、娜娜莉、花园里的女孩、游梦人们……带你们所有人出去！
Text.LocalizedString: Along with Nanally, the girl in the garden, and all the Dreamwalkers!
That won't do! The rules… the rules…

Text.SourceString: 你忘了吗？我从一开始进来，你就说我不受规则束缚。
Text.LocalizedString: Remember? When I first entered here, you told me the rules here don't apply to me.

Text.SourceString: 那些困住你们的过去和幻象……我来打破！
Text.LocalizedString: The past and the illusions that bind you… I'll shatter them all!

Text.SourceString: 一个空空如也的「0」，正适合兜走一群乱七八糟的家伙们！
Text.LocalizedString: Here, I am the embodiment of neverness. I might as well bring back these riffraffs!

Text.SourceString: 既然那个船舵可以载人驶向过去
Text.LocalizedString: If that helm can steer people to the past,

Text.SourceString: 那就由我来让它调转方向
Text.LocalizedString: Then I can change its direction—
No more sailing into the past…

Text.SourceString: 你们的双腿都该往前走
Text.LocalizedString: All of you are meant to move on.
Thyme,
You should try like the others.

Text.SourceString: 抱着愤怒、沮丧、不甘、遗憾
Text.LocalizedString: Carry your anger, sadness, frustration, and regret,

Text.SourceString: 眼里噙满泪水去亲眼看看前方的风景
Text.LocalizedString: Then behold what lies ahead with those teared-up eyes!
C-Come at me if you can!
Left, mine. Right, yours.
Huh?
Have you ever seen this?
I dunno…

Text.SourceString: 能找的地方都找过了，你确定这里真有异象？
Text.LocalizedString: We've looked through every corner. Are you sure there's an anomaly?
There's one more location.
Where exactly?
The rooftop!

Text.SourceString: 异象无首铁驭已泯除，收到，交给我吧！
Text.LocalizedString: The Headless Rider has been nullified. Got it… leave the rest to me.
Is she from the Bureau?
The game… begins!
Nice one!
Now… it's my turn!
What a monster…

Text.SourceString: 到底什么时候才能结束……？
Text.LocalizedString: When will this ever end…?
Alright then, as you… WISH!

Text.SourceString: 主人久等了，这是您点的……
Text.LocalizedString: Master, thanks for waiting. This is…
…the "Yumyum ☆ Magical Omurice" you ordered!

Text.SourceString: 不要忘记「美味☆魔法」，加油啊！
Text.LocalizedString: Don't forget to cast "Yumyum ☆ Magic"!

Text.SourceString: ……接下来，让我来为主人施加美味的魔法吧。
Text.LocalizedString: And now… let me cast a spell that makes Master's food yummy.
With all my love for master mine…
Worries fade with all this rhyme…
Mister Omurice, taste so sweet…
Moe moe magic, what a treat!
There.
It's time for dinner…
Slice it like this?
Good knife skills.
Cheers!
How is it?
Delicious.

Text.SourceString: 对了果果，给你拿着，你来丢！
Text.LocalizedString: Right, Taya, take this. Throw it!
Umm… like this?

Text.SourceString: 没错没错！那么这次奇幻游戏之旅——
Text.LocalizedString: That's right! Now, let our fantasy adventure—
—officially begin!
Who are you? What kind of person…
Do you want to be this time?
What is…?

Text.SourceString: 大概是我们的职业，什么的吧。
Text.LocalizedString: I think it's something like our class.
Why do I look like this…?
What shenanigans are you up to?
Wooaaah! Taya, you're so cool!
Are you sure…?

Text.SourceString: 我饱啦~剩下的全留给你们咯！
Text.LocalizedString: I'm full! You three can have the rest!

Text.SourceString: 你们怎么啦？不觉得自己买的东西味道很不错吗？
Text.LocalizedString: How's that for you? Don't you think the stuff you bought is delicious?
Nitsa...
Senpai! Under us…
Umm?
Run!
Senpai!
Senpai!
Appraiser, Appraiser, look at this—
It's so pretty…!

Text.SourceString: 灵可喜欢的话，就收下吧。
Text.LocalizedString: Linko, you can have it if you want.
Really? Is that okay?

Text.SourceString: 我很喜欢……谢谢鉴定师，我会好好珍藏的。
Text.LocalizedString: Mhm, I like it… Thank you, Appraiser. I'll treasure it.
What about the pudding?
Oh, pudding…! I'll trade in this one instead!

Text.SourceString: 这么大的贝壳，应该能换两个……到时候，我和鉴定师一人一个！
Text.LocalizedString: The shell is so huge, I should be able to get two puddings… Appraiser, we'll get one each!
This TV is acting strange…

Text.SourceString: 啊……会不会有什么很可怕的东西！啊！摄像机出故障了！
Text.LocalizedString: Is there going to be something… scary? Ah! The camera isn't working!
Let me take a look.
(Xiaozhen! Hurry!)
(I hear you!)
The screen stabilized.
Hmm? The TV is broken…
Who's there?
Woah!!!

Text.SourceString: 鉴定师！你还活着吗？鉴定师！鉴定师——
Text.LocalizedString: Appraiser! Are you still alive? Appraiser! Appraiser!
Alright, dear citizens of Hethereau!

Text.SourceString: 激动人心的评选时刻正式开始！让我们有请萌萌评审团的各位评委~
Text.LocalizedString: And now, the moment we've all been waiting for! Let's give it up for—our panel of cuteness judges!
Appraiser!?
Here comes our first contestant!
So nervous…
Wut? Wotcha lookin' at?

Text.SourceString: 哈？！！你给我戴的什么东西？
Text.LocalizedString: Huuuh? What are you making me wear???
You scamp—!
I also rate her a ten.

Text.SourceString: 不许打分！你们这些笨蛋——
Text.LocalizedString: You dummies don't get to rate me! Stop—
I rate Xiaozhen a hundred points!

Text.SourceString: 等等。这些家具，似乎没有攻击的意图。
Text.LocalizedString: Wait, the furniture pieces aren't going to attack us.
That noise they're making…

Text.SourceString: 拐杖……敲击地板的声音？是在模拟前主人在家时的情形吗？
Text.LocalizedString: A cane… thumping on the floor? Are they imitating how it was like with their previous owner?

Text.SourceString: 和前主人分开后，这群孩子一定很寂寞吧。所以才故意发出奇怪的动静，希望有人能注意到它们。
Text.LocalizedString: The little ones must be lonely after parting with their previous owner. That's why they were making unusual noises, hoping someone would notice them.
Appraiser…?

Text.SourceString: 原来你还有无实物表演的天赋。
Text.LocalizedString: Turns out you got a talent for miming.
Can I… also have a cup?
Cough… cough, cough, cough…
Haru!

Text.SourceString: 好久没一下子说这么多话，呛着啦。
Text.LocalizedString: Goodness, I haven't talked so much in a while. Choked myself right up.

Text.SourceString: 魔女小姐，我老了。你却没怎么变过呢。
Text.LocalizedString: Witch lady. I grew older, but you haven't changed.
…I'm a witch lady, after all.

Text.SourceString: 或许……这是我最后一次回到海特洛来拜访魔女小姐啦。
Text.LocalizedString: Perhaps… this is the last time I come to visit you at Hethereau.
Let's chat a bit longer.
I'll fill up the teapot. Be right back.
Let me help.
Blackbird…?

Text.SourceString: 真希望小晴……能一直这么幸福。
Text.LocalizedString: I hope Haru… can keep on being happy.

Text.SourceString: 接下来黑羽是不是要使用操纵油门和方向盘的魔法了？
Text.LocalizedString: Blackbird, are you going to cast a spell that maneuvers the car for you?

Text.SourceString: 当然不会，不过——是你的话肯定没问题
Text.LocalizedString: Of course not. But… I'm sure you can deal with this. Sit tight.
…Huh?
Sit tight.
Wait—
Watch out!
Argh—!
Alright, we're here.

Text.SourceString: （海特洛治安所提醒您：道路千万条，安全第一条，请规范驾驶，遵守交规）
Text.LocalizedString: (The Hethereau Security Office reminds you: There are countless roads, but safety always comes first. Please drive responsibly and obey traffic laws.)
Is that also… an antique?

Text.SourceString: 好像是塔吉多最近收来的……家用点唱机？
Text.LocalizedString: I think Taygedo brought that in recently… A jukebox?
Is it turned on?
Are you going to pose?
It's beautiful here.

Text.SourceString: 采访一下……猫头音！！！！的主唱大人，方便透露透露下一首歌是什么吗？
Text.LocalizedString: Lead singer of The Whoots!!!!, mind sharing what your next song is about?
I do mind.
Why aren't you in the pictures?

Text.SourceString: 猫头音！！！！的鼓手大人……不摆个姿势吗？
Text.LocalizedString: Lead drummer, aren't you going to pose?
Run!
Appraiser.
Blackbird!
A balloon…
You got me!

Text.SourceString: 是吗？可是我总觉得，我好像还没找到呢。
Text.LocalizedString: Have I? It doesn't feel like I found you already.

Text.SourceString: 你意识到了啊，那么很可惜，你没有找到！你输啦！
Text.LocalizedString: You knew? Very well, you didn't find me! You lost!
Come on over, take your pick!
This is it!
Come by and browse again!
(This should do it…)
Huh?
Oh, you're…

Text.SourceString: 妮夏照片上那位……副队长？
Text.LocalizedString: You're the lieutenant… from Nitsa's picture?

Text.SourceString: 太好了，真的是你，我是来找你和Exe队长汇合……
Text.LocalizedString: Great, it really is you. I'm here to help you rendezvous with your captain, Exe.

Text.SourceString: 破坏掉了你的登录端口
Text.LocalizedString: I nuked your login.
"Variable Z"
What… does that mean?
Sorry.
Before I'm done…

Text.SourceString: 暂时会让你退登到一个安全的地方。
Text.LocalizedString: I'll log you out to somewhere safe for now.

Text.SourceString: 电脑里的东西都是虚构的，这都分不清吗？
Text.LocalizedString: Everything in computers is virtual. Can't you even tell?

Text.SourceString: 说是电脑里的人物死了，怎么可能按照这个去定罪啊……
Text.LocalizedString: A character in the computer died. How's that grounds for a conviction…?

Text.SourceString: 一台废品电脑，几个存档。砸了就砸了呗。
Text.LocalizedString: It's just a worthless PC with some save files. Who cares if it's trashed?

Text.SourceString: 游戏玩得脑子进水的有见过，没见过去臆想自己真杀了人的。
Text.LocalizedString: Seen plenty of gamers with their brains fried, but never one who convinced himself he actually killed someone.
The BAC already did a search, right?

Text.SourceString: 嗯，除开他自己受了点伤之外，没什么大事。
Text.LocalizedString: Yep. He got himself hurt, but that's about it.

Text.SourceString: 果然啊，这根本就不该当个案子来报的，那孩子非要自顾自这么乱搞……
Text.LocalizedString: I knew it. This never should've been a case. That kid just had to go do his own thing…

Text.SourceString: 从未深究过对方的真实姓名、性别、容貌、身份和来历，一无所知的「X」。
Text.LocalizedString: X never dug into the other one's real name, gender, looks, identity, or background. He knew nothing.

Text.SourceString: 满足于维持现状、视一切为理所当然、天真又傲慢、无忧无虑的「X」。
Text.LocalizedString: Naive and arrogant, X was content with the status quo. He took everything for granted and didn't have a care in the world.

Text.SourceString: 在没有尸体的「Y」损毁到无影无踪之后，当然无法证明它「真的存在过」。
Text.LocalizedString: Once destroyed, there was absolutely no trace of Y left behind. Of course there was no way to prove that Y ever really "existed."
How many times have I dreamt about this?

Text.SourceString: 早就习惯了，别白费力气。
Text.LocalizedString: I'm used to it. Don't even bother.
Nothing would have changed.
…What a pity.

Text.SourceString: 明明只要向电话那头请求再见……
Text.LocalizedString: When all you had to do was pick up the phone and ask to meet up again…

Text.SourceString: 缺憾将得以弥补，故事将得以延续。
Text.LocalizedString: What was missing would be made whole, and the story would go on.

Text.SourceString: 「X」，我们互相道歉然后和好吧！我先来~
Text.LocalizedString: X, let's apologize to each other and start over! I'll go first!

Text.SourceString: 对不起！以后我一定百分百支持你的意愿！再也不和你吵架啦！我发誓！
Text.LocalizedString: I'm sorry! From now on, I'll support whatever you want! 100%! No more fights ever! I swear!

Text.SourceString: 其实，「我也想永远都和你在一起玩！」
Text.LocalizedString: "Honestly, I wanna hang out with you forever too!"

Text.SourceString: 验证结果——用户「X」在「空号」系统中，始终是一个无法解析的异常值。
Text.LocalizedString: Results: within the "Invalid Number" system, user X has always been an anomaly that couldn't be resolved.
You done yet?
I'm done.
In this way…

Text.SourceString: 他宁可拒接那条温柔的、轻松的、能够通往未来的路线。
Text.LocalizedString: …he'd sooner refuse that gentle, easy path, the one that led to a future…

Text.SourceString: 也要死守他的痛苦、悔恨、那些珍贵的记忆与真切的时光……
Text.LocalizedString: …and still hold onto his pain, his regret, those precious memories and time together, until he dies.
